docs.title: StellarPayWall ⚡
docs.text:
High-Throughput HTTP 402 Micropayment API Gateway powered by Stellar & Soroban smart contracts.

📖 Documentation Portal: https://HassanKorey.github.io/StellarPayWall-app 🚀 Live Merchant Gateway: https://stellarpaywall.onrender.com 📚 Interactive API Docs (Swagger UI): https://stellarpaywall.onrender.com/docs 🩺 System Health Check: https://stellarpaywall.onrender.com/health

docs.title: 🌟 Overview
docs.text:
StellarPayWall is an open-source, production-ready micropayment API gateway implementing the standard HTTP 402 Payment Required protocol over the Stellar Network and Soroban smart contracts.

It empowers API developers, data providers, and autonomous AI agents (such as LangChain and CrewAI agents) to monetize digital endpoints on a trustless, pay-per-request basis with fractions of a cent per call and sub-5-second finality.

docs.title: Key Capabilities
docs.text:
• Native HTTP 402 Handshake: Automatically challenges unauthorized API calls with RFC-compliant WWW-Authenticate payment instructions.
  • Dual Verification Engines: Verifies both native Stellar Horizon payments (XLM) and Soroban Asset Contract (SAC / SEP-41 USDC/XLM) token transfers.
  • Atomic Anti-Replay Nonce Ledger: Built with SQLite WAL journaling and Redis caching, featuring configurable TTL locks to eliminate double-spend race conditions.
  • Dynamic Pricing Engine: Calculates per-endpoint price tiers based on resource complexity and load.
  • Modern SDKs: Client libraries for Python and TypeScript/Node.js with automatic 402 response interception and seamless transaction signing.
  • Next.js Merchant Dashboard: Real-time telemetry, revenue monitoring, and API key management.

docs.title: 1. Make an Unauthenticated Request
docs.text: curl -i https://stellarpaywall.onrender.com/protected-resource

docs.title: 2. Receive HTTP 402 Challenge
docs.text:
HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required
WWW-Authenticate: Stellar asset="XLM", amount="0.05", destination="merchant_address", challenge="a4b3c2d1-..."
X-PayWall-Amount: 0.05
X-PayWall-Asset: XLM
X-PayWall-Destination: merchant_address
X-PayWall-Challenge-UUID: a4b3c2d1-...
X-PayWall-Expires-In: 300

docs.title: 3. Settle On-Chain & Access Resource
docs.text:
Submit a Stellar payment transaction with the challenge UUID set as the transaction MEMO_TEXT: 

curl -i https://stellarpaywall.onrender.com/protected-resource \
  -H "X-PayWall-Tx-Hash: <YOUR_STELLAR_TRANSACTION_HASH>" \
  -H "X-PayWall-Challenge-UUID: a4b3c2d1-..."
Response: 
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{"message": "Premium content accessed successfully."}

docs.title: 🛡️ Standard Error Codes
docs.text: Status Code Reason Resolution 400 Bad Request Transaction already spent or invalid hash format Generate a new transaction with a fresh challenge UUID. 402 Payment Required Challenge issued, underpayment, or invalid memo Sign and submit an on-chain transaction matching the challenge requirements. 500 Internal Server Error Transient RPC or network failure Retry request using exponential backoff.

docs.title: System Architecture 🏛️
docs.text: StellarPayWall is designed for high throughput, sub-second latency, and uncompromising cryptographic security. It bridges standard RESTful HTTP clients and autonomous AI agents with the high-speed Stellar blockchain and Soroban smart contract runtime.

docs.title: 📐 High-Level Architecture Diagram
docs.text:
flowchart TD
    subgraph Clients["Consumers & Autonomous Agents"]
        Agent["Autonomous AI Agent (LangChain / CrewAI)"]
        WebBrowser["Web App / dApp Consumer"]
        PyClient["Python Client SDK"]
        TSClient["TypeScript / Node.js SDK"]
    end

    subgraph Gateway["StellarPayWall Gateway (FastAPI Core)"]
        Middleware["HTTP 402 Middleware\n(Intercepts request & checks headers)"]
        ReplayGuard["Replay Guard Middleware\n(Checks in-flight & spent hashes)"]

        subgraph CoreServices["Internal Gateway Services"]
            DynamicPrice["Dynamic Pricing Engine"]
            HorizonVerifier["Horizon Payment Verifier"]
            SorobanVerifier["Soroban SAC Event Verifier"]
        end

        subgraph LedgerLayer["Anti-Replay Nonce Ledger"]
            Mutex["Asyncio Key-Level Mutex"]
            Storage["SQLite (WAL) / Redis Backend\n(TTL Auto-Expiration)"]
        end
    end

    subgraph StellarNetwork["Stellar Distributed Ledger"]
        HorizonNode["Stellar Horizon RPC Node"]
        SorobanRPC["Soroban RPC getTransaction Endpoint"]
        PaywallVault["paywall_vault Smart Contract\n(SEP-41 Soroban Asset Contract)"]
    end

    Middleware -->|2. Returns 402 + Challenge UUID| Clients
    Clients -->|3. Submits Micropayment Tx| StellarNetwork
    Clients -->|4. Retries Request + Tx Hash| Middleware

    Mutex --> Storage

    Middleware --> SorobanVerifier

    SorobanVerifier --> SorobanRPC
    SorobanRPC --> PaywallVault

    Storage -->|Verified Nonce Stored with TTL| Middleware

docs.title: 🗂️ Dual-Repository Workspace Split
docs.text: Following the Stellar Wave Builder Maintainer Playbook, StellarPayWall is architecturally divided into two specialized workspaces:

docs.title: 1. HassanKorey/StellarPayWall-contract
docs.text:
• Language: #![no_std] Rust with soroban-sdk v21.0.0.
  • Components:
  • paywall_vault: Smart contract handling SAC (USDC/XLM) deposit escrow, merchant claims, and PaymentVerified event emission.
  • Verification getters: get_admin, get_token, get_payment_status, and verify_payment_memo.
  • Comprehensive unit test suite with mock auths and asset contracts (cargo test).

docs.title: 2. HassanKorey/StellarPayWall-app
docs.text:
• Language & Frameworks: Python 3.12 (FastAPI, Uvicorn, Pydantic v2), Next.js 14, Tailwind CSS.
  • Components:
  • stellarpaywall/middleware/: ASGI middleware for HTTP 402 challenge negotiation and replay protection.
  • stellarpaywall/services/: Horizon RPC client with exponential backoff and Soroban RPC getTransaction event parser for SEP-41 token transfers.
  • stellarpaywall/ledger.py: Nonce ledger featuring atomic key-level locks, SQLite WAL journaling, Redis distributed caching, and TTL auto-expiration.
  • frontend/: Next.js merchant dashboard for revenue metrics and API key controls.
  • sdks/: Python and TypeScript SDKs.
  • docs/: MkDocs documentation portal deployed to GitHub Pages.

docs.title: 🛡️ Nonce Ledger & Replay Prevention
docs.text:
Transaction replay attacks represent the primary vulnerability in HTTP micropayment architectures. StellarPayWall mitigates this via a three-tier defense:

  1. In-Flight Mutex (asyncio.Lock): When a request arrives with an X-PayWall-Tx-Hash, the ledger locks that specific hash key. Concurrent requests attempting to use the same hash simultaneously are serialized and blocked.
  2. Atomic Ledger Commitment: Transactions are recorded inside an atomic database transaction. If an attacker attempts to reuse an existing hash, the SQLite UNIQUE(tx_hash) constraint or Redis SETNX immediately aborts the verification.
  3. Configurable TTL Rent / Expiration: Nonces expire after a configurable TTL (default: 3600 seconds), ensuring database pruning while maintaining complete double-spend resistance during the challenge validity window.

docs.title: HTTP 402 Micropayment Protocol 📜
docs.text: The HTTP 402 Payment Required status code is an HTTP standard reserved for digital cash systems. StellarPayWall realizes this standard on the Stellar blockchain, turning any API endpoint into a pay-per-use monetized asset.

docs.title: 🔄 Protocol Sequence Diagram
docs.text:
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor Client as Client / AI Agent
    participant Gateway as StellarPayWall Gateway
    participant NonceDB as Anti-Replay Ledger
    participant Stellar as Stellar / Soroban Network

    Client->>Gateway: GET /protected-resource (no credentials)
    Gateway-->>Client: 402 Payment Required<br/>[WWW-Authenticate, X-PayWall-Challenge-UUID, X-PayWall-Amount]

    Note over Client: Client reads challenge UUID & amount,<br/>signs on-chain Stellar transaction with UUID memo

    Client->>Stellar: Broadcast payment transaction (XLM or SAC USDC)
    Stellar-->>Client: Transaction Confirmed (tx_hash)

    Client->>Gateway: GET /protected-resource<br/>[X-PayWall-Tx-Hash: tx_hash, X-PayWall-Challenge-UUID: UUID]

    Gateway->>NonceDB: Check if tx_hash is spent / acquire mutex lock
    NonceDB-->>Gateway: Hash clean & unlocked

    alt Stellar Native Payment
        Gateway->>Stellar: Fetch Horizon transaction details
        Stellar-->>Gateway: Status: success, amount, destination, memo
    else Soroban SAC Payment
        Gateway->>Stellar: RPC getTransaction(tx_hash)
        Stellar-->>Gateway: Contract event logs (SEP-41 transfer / PaymentVerified)
    end

    Note over Gateway: Verifier confirms amount >= required,<br/>destination == merchant, memo == challenge UUID

    Gateway->>NonceDB: Record verified tx_hash with TTL lock
    NonceDB-->>Gateway: Committed

    Gateway-->>Client: 200 OK + Resource Content

docs.title: 📋 Challenge Specification
docs.text: When an endpoint protected by HTTP402Middleware receives an unauthenticated request, it responds with:

docs.title: Response Headers
docs.text: Header Description Example WWW-Authenticate RFC-compliant authentication challenge string Stellar asset="XLM", amount="0.05", destination="merchant_address", challenge="b3a9c2..." X-PayWall-Amount Required payment amount in units of the asset 0.05 X-PayWall-Asset Accepted asset (XLM, USDC, or SAC Contract ID) XLM X-PayWall-Destination Merchant Stellar public key or contract address GBBD47IF6LWK7P7MDEVSCWR7DPUWV3NY3DTQEVFL4NAT4AQH3ZLLFLA5 X-PayWall-Challenge-UUID Unique cryptographic nonce tying payment to request d7a5b3e2-89f4-4e2b-a01c-72149b18204d X-PayWall-Expires-In Challenge validity window in seconds 300

docs.title: Response Body
docs.text:
{
  "detail": "Payment Required"
}

docs.title: 💳 Payment Construction
docs.text: Clients have two settlement paths:

docs.title: Option A: Stellar Native Horizon Payment (XLM)
docs.text:
1. Build a PaymentOperation transferring at least X-PayWall-Amount to X-PayWall-Destination.
  2. Attach the X-PayWall-Challenge-UUID as Memo.text(challenge_uuid).
  3. Sign and broadcast to the Stellar Network.
  4. Obtain the transaction hash tx_hash.

docs.title: Option B: Soroban SAC Smart Contract Invocation (paywall_vault)
docs.text:
1. Invoke the pay_for_resource contract function: 
    pay_for_resource(
    payer: Address,
    request_id: Symbol(challenge_uuid),
    amount: i128(scaled_amount)
)
  2. The contract transfers the SAC tokens into escrow and emits a PaymentVerified event with topic (PaymentVerified, request_id) and data amount.
  3. Obtain transaction hash tx_hash.

docs.title: 🔑 Request Authorization Submission
docs.text:
Retry the request including the proof-of-payment headers:

GET /protected-resource HTTP/1.1
Host: stellarpaywall.onrender.com
X-PayWall-Tx-Hash: 4b29f0e1c2a8d3e...
X-PayWall-Challenge-UUID: d7a5b3e2-89f4-4e2b-a01c-72149b18204d

docs.title: Protocol Status Codes
docs.text: Status Code Meaning Cause 200 OK Access Granted Payment verified, destination matched, memo validated, hash committed to ledger. 402 Payment Required Challenge / Invalid Payment No payment provided, underpayment, wrong destination, wrong asset, or memo mismatch. 400 Bad Request Replay Attack Transaction hash was already spent or is currently in-flight.

docs.title: Python Client SDK 🐍
docs.text: The StellarPayWall Python SDK provides an asynchronous HTTP client that transparently handles the HTTP 402 Payment Required challenge handshake, builds and signs Stellar transactions, and retries the request with proof-of-payment headers.

docs.title: 📦 Installation
docs.text:
pip install stellarpaywall-sdk
# Or directly from source:
pip install git+https://github.com/HassanKorey/StellarPayWall-app.git#subdirectory=sdks/python

docs.title: ⚡ Quick Start: Automatic 402 Interceptor
docs.text:
The AsyncStellarPayWallClient automatically detects 402 responses, parses the challenge headers, constructs a Stellar micropayment transaction, submits it to the Horizon or Soroban RPC network, and returns the successful 200 OK response without requiring manual challenge handling.

import asyncio
from stellarpaywall_client import AsyncStellarPayWallClient

async def main():
    client = AsyncStellarPayWallClient(
        secret_key="S...",          # Stellar account secret seed (funded via Friendbot on testnet)
        base_url="https://stellarpaywall.onrender.com",
        network_passphrase="Test SDF Network ; September 2015",
    )

    # Calling a protected resource automatically negotiates 402 payment:
    response = await client.get("/protected-resource")
    print("Status:", response.status_code)
    print("Content:", response.json())

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

docs.title: 🤖 AI Agent Integration (LangChain & CrewAI)
docs.text: StellarPayWall SDK provides drop-in tool wrappers for autonomous agent frameworks:

docs.title: LangChain Tool Adapter
docs.text:
from langchain.tools import tool
from stellarpaywall_client import AsyncStellarPayWallClient

client = AsyncStellarPayWallClient(
    secret_key="S...",
    base_url="https://stellarpaywall.onrender.com",
)

@tool
async def query_premium_market_data(query: str) -> str:
    """Queries premium financial analytics behind a Stellar 402 paywall."""
    res = await client.get(f"/api/v1/analyze?q={query}")
    return res.text

docs.title: CrewAI Agent Integration
docs.text:
from crewai import Agent, Task, Crew
from stellarpaywall_client import AsyncStellarPayWallClient

class MonetizedAPITool:
    def __init__(self, secret_key: str):
        self.client = AsyncStellarPayWallClient(secret_key=secret_key)

    def fetch_data(self, endpoint: str) -> dict:
        import asyncio
        return asyncio.run(self.client.get(endpoint)).json()

researcher = Agent(
    role="Web3 Financial Analyst",
    goal="Retrieve real-time market data through monetized API endpoints",
    backstory="Autonomous analyst funded with testnet XLM to query high-value paywalled APIs.",
    verbose=True,

docs.title: TypeScript / JavaScript Client SDK 🌐
docs.text: The StellarPayWall TypeScript SDK (@stellarpaywall/sdk) provides a modern, typed client library for Node.js, Next.js, and browser environments. It includes an automatic Axios / fetch interceptor for HTTP 402 micro-transactions on Stellar and Soroban.

docs.title: 📦 Installation
docs.text:
npm install @stellarpaywall/sdk @stellar/stellar-sdk
# or via pnpm / yarn:
pnpm add @stellarpaywall/sdk @stellar/stellar-sdk

docs.title: ⚡ Quick Start: Node.js Backend Client
docs.text:
import { StellarPayWallClient } from '@stellarpaywall/sdk';
import { Keypair, Networks } from '@stellar/stellar-sdk';

const signerKeypair = Keypair.fromSecret('S...');

const client = new StellarPayWallClient({
  baseUrl: 'https://stellarpaywall.onrender.com',
  networkPassphrase: Networks.TESTNET,
  horizonUrl: 'https://horizon-testnet.stellar.org',
  keypair: signerKeypair,
});

async function run() {
  // Requests to protected endpoints automatically negotiate 402 challenge
  const response = await client.get('/protected-resource');
  console.log('Status:', response.status);
  console.log('Payload:', response.data);
}

run().catch(console.error);

docs.title: 🔌 Axios Interceptor Plug-in
docs.text:
If you already use an existing axios instance in your application, you can attach the StellarPayWall 402 interceptor directly:

import axios from 'axios';
import { attachPayWallInterceptor } from '@stellarpaywall/sdk';
import { Keypair, Networks } from '@stellar/stellar-sdk';

const api = axios.create({
  baseURL: 'https://stellarpaywall.onrender.com',
});

const keypair = Keypair.fromSecret('S...');

attachPayWallInterceptor(api, {
  keypair,
  networkPassphrase: Networks.TESTNET,
  maxPriceLimit: '0.10', // Max XLM willing to pay per request
});

// All API calls now automatically pay the 402 challenge:
const res = await api.get('/protected-resource');
console.log(res.data);

docs.title: 👛 Browser / Freighter Wallet Integration
docs.text:
For frontend web applications, you can connect the Freighter browser wallet to sign 402 transactions on behalf of the user:

import { StellarPayWallBrowserClient } from '@stellarpaywall/sdk';
import { isConnected, signTransaction } from '@stellar/freighter-api';

const browserClient = new StellarPayWallBrowserClient({
  baseUrl: 'https://stellarpaywall.onrender.com',
  signTransaction: async (xdr: string) => {
    return await signTransaction(xdr, { network: 'TESTNET' });
  },
});
